title: AI-Based Malware Classification System
description: Modern malware variants constantly change their signatures to evade traditional antivirus systems. AIbased malware classification systems can analyze behavioral patterns, file structures, and execution traces to identify malicious software.
challenges: Detecting polymorphic and obfuscated malware
Handling large malware datasets efficiently
Reducing false positives while maintaining detection accuracy

title: AI-Based Document Forgery Detection
description: Fraudsters manipulate digital documents such as ID cards, certificates, and invoices. AI-based systems can analyze image inconsistencies, text anomalies, and metadata to detect forged documents. These systems may use computer vision, pattern recognition, and machine learning techniques to identify alterations such as tampered text, inconsistent fonts, altered signatures.
challenges: Detecting subtle manipulations in scanned documents
Handling multiple document formats and layouts
Ensuring high detection accuracy for real-world use cases

title: AI-Based Insider Threat Detection
description: Insider threats are difficult to detect because malicious activities often appear as legitimate system behavior. Employees with authorized access may intentionally or unintentionally misuse sensitive data.
challenges: Identifying abnormal behavior among legitimate users
Analyzing large volumes of user activity logs
Minimizing false alerts while maintaining high detection accuracy

title: AI-Powered Data Privacy Compliance Checker
description: An AI-powered compliance checker can automatically analyze databases, logs, and storage systems to detect exposure of sensitive information, identify policy violations, and ensure adherence to data protection standards such as GDPR or other privacy frameworks.
challenges: Identifying personally identifiable information (PII) in large datasets
Detecting unauthorized access or data leaks
Ensuring compliance without affecting operational efficiency

title: Adversarial Attack Detection for AI Models
description: Machine learning models can be manipulated using adversarial examples—inputs that are slightly modified in ways that are often imperceptible to humans but cause the AI model to make incorrect predictions. These attacks can compromise systems used in areas such as autonomous driving, facial recognition, and cybersecurity.
challenges: Ensuring detection works across different types of AI models
Protecting AI systems from manipulation without affecting model performance

title: Poisoned Dataset Detection
description: The goal is to build a detection system that analyzes datasets to identify suspicious or manipulated data points before they are used in model training. The system should automatically flag or remove potentially poisoned samples to ensure the integrity and reliability of the training data.
challenges: Identifying subtle malicious patterns in large datasets
Differentiating between legitimate outliers and poisoned data points
Maintaining model performance after removing suspicious data

title: AI-Powered Multi-Modal Deepfake Detection and Authentication System
description: Deepfake technologies can generate highly realistic fake media that can be used for misinformation, fraud, and identity impersonation. An AI-based system can analyze visual, audio, and metadata signals to detect manipulated media and verify authenticity.
challenges: Detecting deepfakes across images, videos, and audio
Identifying subtle inconsistencies like facial expressions and audio-visual mismatches
Supporting real-time detection with high accuracy

title: Centralized Application Firewall System
description: Organizations need a centralized firewall system to monitor and control application network communication.
challenges: Managing security policies across multiple endpoints
Detecting abnormal or malicious network activities
Ensuring minimal impact on application performance

title: Web Application Supply Chain Security Scanner
description: Modern web applications depend heavily on external packages and libraries. These dependencies may contain known security vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit. The system should analyze application dependencies and alert developers about vulnerable libraries with recommended fixes.
challenges: Detecting vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies
Continuously updating vulnerability databases
Providing accurate alerts and remediation suggestions to developers

title: Secure API Gateway for Web Applications
description: Modern applications rely heavily on APIs to exchange data between services. If APIs are not properly secured, they can expose sensitive information or allow attackers to exploit system functionality
challenges: Preventing unauthorized API access
Implementing effective rate limiting and abuse detection
Maintaining high performance while enforcing security controls

title: Digital Intelligence Aggregation Platform
description: Develop a Digital Intelligence Aggregation Platform that combines multiple OSINT capabilities into a single system, enabling investigators to collect and analyze intelligence from publicly available digital sources through a unified interface.
challenges: Building OSINT collection modules from scratch without relying on external APIs
Aggregating and organizing data from multiple open sources
Handling large volumes of intelligence while maintaining performance and accuracy

title: Early Warning System for Android Ransomware
description: There is a need for an early warning system to detect ransomware activity on Android devices before major damage occurs.
challenges: Designing a lightweight system that does not affect device performance.
Implementing accurate alerts with low false positives
Developing preventive mechanisms such as warnings or rollback option

title: Secure DNS Filtering System
description: Attackers frequently use DNS to communicate with command-and-control (C2) servers. This system aims to build a secure DNS filtering solution that detects and blocks malicious domains in real time using threat intelligence and anomaly detection techniques.
challenges: Detecting domains generated by Domain Generation Algorithms (DGA)
Identifying DNS tunneling attempts over modern protocols like DoH and DoT
Maintaining fast DNS resolution with minimal latency

title: Automated Fuzzing for IoT Protocols
description: An automated fuzzing framework can generate malformed or unexpected inputs to test these protocols and identify potential weaknesses in their communication stacks.
challenges: Implementing fuzzing techniques for protocols like WPA2/WPA3 and BLE
Detecting crashes and identifying unique vulnerabilities automatically

title: Dark Web Monitoring and Keyword Search Tool
description: Anonymous networks such as TOR, I2P, and Freenet host platforms that may contain illegal marketplaces or malicious activities. The system should collect and filter data from these networks based on keywords, locations, and timestamps to help investigators monitor suspicious activities.
challenges: Establishing secure connectivity through VPN or anonymity networks.
Extracting data from dynamic and frequently changing dark web sources.
Managing continuously changing dark web resources while maintaining operational security.

title: Cybersecurity Readiness Assessment Tool
description: Many organizations struggle to evaluate how prepared they are for threats such as malware, phishing, and data breaches. This tool will assess an organization's capabilities across areas like prevention, detection, response, and recovery, and generate a cybersecurity maturity score with recommendations.
challenges: Designing a reliable assessment framework
Generating meaningful maturity scores and actionable recommendations
Ensuring the confidentiality and security of assessment data

title: Software-Defined Load Balancer, Firewall, and WAF for Cloud-Native Applications
description: Design and integrate a software-defined load balancer, firewall, and web application firewall (WAF) for cloudnative application stacks.
challenges: Selecting and integrating suitable open-source security solutions
Implementing WAF rules to protect applications from web attacks
Ensuring seamless integration with cloud orchestration platforms

title: Unified Monitoring Solution for VMs and Containers
description: Create a unified monitoring system for both virtual machines (VMs) and containerized environments.
challenges: Collecting metrics from diverse environments (VMs and containers)
Efficiently storing large volumes of monitoring data
Designing dashboards and alert mechanisms for realtime monitoring

title: Insecure Serverless Application
description: Serverless applications may contain security vulnerabilities due to insecure dependencies, improper permissions, or weak configurations.
challenges: Identifying insecure dependencies in serverless functions
Detecting improper permissions and configuration issues
Providing automated security checks without affecting application performance

title: Kubernetes RBAC Privilege Escalation via Wildcard Permissions
description: Identify and mitigate Kubernetes RBAC misconfigurations involving wildcard (*) permissions that may grant excessive privileges to service accounts and increase the risk of unauthorized access within the cluster.
challenges: Detecting wildcard or overly permissive RBAC rules in cluster configurations
Auditing service accounts and role bindings for excessive privileges
Enforcing least-privilege RBAC policies and automated compliance checks using security tools and policy frameworks.

title: Sybil Attacks on Decentralized Identity (DID) Systems
description: Decentralized Identity (DID) systems on blockchain are vulnerable to Sybil attacks, where attackers create multiple fake identities to manipulate the network.
challenges: Detecting and eliminating Sybil nodes without relying on centralized authorities
Maintaining privacy and anonymity of legitimate devices
Identifying fraudulent identities in real time without disrupting the network

title: Zero-Day Vulnerabilities in IIoT Smart Contracts
description: Smart contracts in Industrial IoT (IIoT) blockchain networks may contain undiscovered zero-day vulnerabilities that can be exploited by attackers.
challenges: Performing automated security auditing of smart contract code
Detecting malicious contract interactions in real time
Maintaining decentralization while monitoring and preventing attacks

title: Cross-Chain Bridge Trust Gaps
description: Industrial IoT ecosystems may use multiple blockchain networks that communicate through cross-chain bridges. During this transfer, cryptographic continuity can break, allowing attackers to inject falsified device telemetry or manipulate data as it moves between blockchains.
challenges: Maintaining end-to-end cryptographic proof across different blockchain networks
Detecting anomalies during cross-chain data transfers
Preventing centralized bridge validators that could become single points of failure

title: IoT Botnet Detection System
description: Design a real-time detection system that identifies IoT devices infected by botnets participating in large-scale DDoS attacks.
challenges: Detecting abnormal traffic patterns from IoT devices
Differentiating between legitimate and malicious network activity
Isolating infected devices without affecting normal network functionality

title: Firmware Integrity Verification System for Industrial IoT
description: Design a lightweight, offline-capable system that verifies firmware integrity in Industrial IoT mesh networks to prevent malicious OTA firmware injection.
challenges: Implementing firmware verification within limited memory and processing capacity of IoT devices
Designing reliable peer verification even if some nodes are compromised
Ensuring update verification does not delay legitimate firmware deployment
